Identifying all RPC methods of ShortcutService and their corresponding backend implementation files.

Reading the ShortcutService proto file to identify RPC definitions, then locating the backend files that implement each method.

All five RPCs are implemented in server/router/api/v1/shortcut_service.go.

Checking connect_services.go to confirm it only delegates RPCs without separate implementations.

All RPCs of ShortcutService are implemented in shortcut_service.go.

There are five RPCs total.

q14.

**RPCs:** ListShortcuts, GetShortcut, CreateShortcut, UpdateShortcut, DeleteShortcut

**Implementing file:** `server/router/api/v1/shortcut_service.go`

All five are declared on `ShortcutService` in `proto/api/v1/shortcut_service.proto` and implemented on `APIV1Service` in that single backend file:

| RPC | Line |
|---|---|
| ListShortcuts | 49 |
| GetShortcut | 95 |
| CreateShortcut | 135 |
| UpdateShortcut | 211 |
| DeleteShortcut | 284 |

`ConnectServiceHandler` in `server/router/api/v1/connect_services.go` only wraps these methods and delegates to `APIV1Service`; the business logic lives in `shortcut_service.go`.
